scope: Selected named Riga restaurant/cafe records with official websites and high menu-source likelihood, excluding app/venues.ts and all new-bars batches
pricingRule: Only official current in-venue menus, current venue menu pages, or clearly current venue tap lists with an explicit beer name, serving volume, and venue price are displayable. Delivery, retail, stale, ambiguous, and inferred prices are excluded.
